rationale_old: ACTIVE (re-enabled; design.md). Fixed O&M is commonly stated as a share of capital cost per year; the share is taken from archetypes in this database with both values sourced, nearest pool of at least five first. Range: the smallest to largest share in that pool. Back-test 2026-10-01 (87 archetypes with both sourced): 71 inside the range, but only 24 centrals within 25% (typical error a factor of 1.7). The shares spread from under 1% to over 12% a year, so treat these as placeholders for the sanity-check pass. Pools of 3 with the 10-90th percentile caught only 50. ACTIVE 2026-10-09 (proposal F1), re-tuned: the pool shares the archetype's product unit (a share per tonne and a share per GJ behave differently), the nearest pool needs 3 archetypes (same equipment) or 5 (family, then all), and the range is the pool's interquartile span rather than its extremes. The capex it scales may itself be a fill; the result inherits that grade. A fourth pool level (2026-10-09) takes archetypes of any product unit, since the ratio is per year of the same unit on both sides; it is reached only where the m3 and m archetypes have no pool of their own. NARROWED 2026-10-24 (sanity-check S142/OG001, OG002): abatement devices (product t of methane or CO2 abated) and product plants never share a ratio pool; the same-equipment pool needs 5 archetypes, like the others. POOL-AS-PLANT 2026-10-28 (Brad, OG002): flare-gas recovery is a compressor station priced like a plant, so it takes its ratio from the non-abating plants at any product unit, not from the methane devices (which had put its O&M at 18% of capex).

inputs_old: capex (sourced); opex-fixed/capex median 0.02343 of 18 archetypes (same family, quartiles 0.0193-0.037)
rationale_old: ACTIVE (re-enabled; design.md). Fixed O&M is commonly stated as a share of capital cost per year; the share is taken from archetypes in this database with both values sourced, nearest pool of at least five first. Range: the smallest to largest share in that pool. Back-test 2026-10-01 (87 archetypes with both sourced): 71 inside the range, but only 24 centrals within 25% (typical error a factor of 1.7). The shares spread from under 1% to over 12% a year, so treat these as placeholders for the sanity-check pass. Pools of 3 with the 10-90th percentile caught only 50. ACTIVE 2026-10-09 (proposal F1), re-tuned: the pool shares the archetype's product unit (a share per tonne and a share per GJ behave differently), the nearest pool needs 3 archetypes (same equipment) or 5 (family, then all), and the range is the pool's interquartile span rather than its extremes. The capex it scales may itself be a fill; the result inherits that grade. A fourth pool level (2026-10-09) takes archetypes of any product unit, since the ratio is per year of the same unit on both sides; it is reached only where the m3 and m archetypes have no pool of their own. NARROWED 2026-10-24 (sanity-check S142/OG001, OG002): abatement devices (product t of methane or CO2 abated) and product plants never share a ratio pool; the same-equipment pool needs 5 archetypes, like the others. The parts are kept as targets host-plant and ccs-add-on; the CIMS export writes the host-plant part plus the service request to the CCS node, which carries the capture cost there. rationale_old: ACTIVE (re-enabled; design.md). Fixed O&M is commonly stated as a share of capital cost per year; the share is taken from archetypes in this database with both values sourced, nearest pool of at least five first. Range: the smallest to largest share in that pool. Back-test 2026-10-01 (87 archetypes with both sourced): 71 inside the range, but only 24 centrals within 25% (typical error a factor of 1.7). The shares spread from under 1% to over 12% a year, so treat these as placeholders for the sanity-check pass. Pools of 3 with the 10-90th percentile caught only 50. ACTIVE 2026-10-09 (proposal F1), re-tuned: the pool shares the archetype's product unit (a share per tonne and a share per GJ behave differently), the nearest pool needs 3 archetypes (same equipment) or 5 (family, then all), and the range is the pool's interquartile span rather than its extremes. The capex it scales may itself be a fill; the result inherits that grade. A fourth pool level (2026-10-09) takes archetypes of any product unit, since the ratio is per year of the same unit on both sides; it is reached only where the m3 and m archetypes have no pool of their own. NARROWED 2026-10-24 (sanity-check S142/OG001, OG002): abatement devices (product t of methane or CO2 abated) and product plants never share a ratio pool; the same-equipment pool needs 5 archetypes, like the others. POOL-AS-PLANT 2026-10-28 (Brad, OG002): flare-gas recovery is a compressor station priced like a plant, so it takes its ratio from the non-abating plants at any product unit, not from the methane devices (which had put its O&M at 18% of capex).
